basics.name: Jane Q. Developer
basics.label: Principal Software Engineer
basics.summary: Principal engineer with fifteen years of experience building distributed systems, developer tooling, and the release infrastructure that keeps them shipping.

work.name: Northwind Systems
work.summary: Technical lead for the platform group that owns build, release, and observability tooling.
highlights: Cut median CI wall-clock time from 42 minutes to 9 by introducing remote build caching.
Designed the multi-region failover strategy now used by all customer-facing services.
Mentored six engineers, three of whom were promoted to senior within two years.

work.name: Contoso Analytics
work.summary: Built and operated the ingestion pipeline behind the company's real-time analytics product.
highlights: Scaled event ingestion from 12K to 400K events per second.
Replaced a nightly batch job with a streaming implementation, reducing data latency to under a minute.

volunteer.summary: Mentored volunteer developers building civic technology for local nonprofits.
highlights: Led a twelve-week curriculum on version control and code review.
Shipped a volunteer-scheduling application used by four regional food banks.

awards.title: Engineering Excellence Award
awards.summary: Awarded annually to one engineer for sustained impact on company-wide technical infrastructure.

awards.title: Best Paper, Industry Track
awards.summary: Recognized for the paper describing Contoso's incremental stream-processing architecture.

publications.name: Incremental Stream Processing at Scale
publications.summary: A practitioner's account of migrating a batch analytics pipeline to a streaming architecture.

publications.name: Reproducible Builds for Polyglot Repositories
publications.summary: Techniques for achieving bit-identical build artifacts across heterogeneous toolchains.

references.name: Alex Rivera, VP of Engineering at Northwind Systems
references.reference: Jane is the engineer other engineers ask for help. She leaves every system she touches simpler than she found it.

references.name: Priya Raman, Director of Data at Contoso Analytics

projects.name: Ledger
projects.description: An append-only event store that guarantees exactly-once delivery to downstream consumers.
highlights: Adopted by three teams within a year of its first release.
Sustains 250K writes per second on commodity hardware.

projects.name: The Cost of a Build
projects.description: A conference talk on the compounding cost of slow feedback loops in continuous integration.
